population: All twelve previously registered sessions 1-2 and 3-4 of the six training histories and all 123 distinct window questions. The orphaned conv-41 sessions 3-4 window has four eligible questions, none with annotated evidence in its terminal span, so the old credit probe did not create an alternative. Process by ascending question count then window name for cost, retaining every window and failure. The previous two-action actor used 24 of these decision labels without raw returns.
writer: Hold the actual first write fixed. Use the two recorded common terminal slots, versioned temporal and activity options, and original source rules. Verify factual raw writer parsing, receipt, bank and the archived alternative where available. On the checked 251 GPU 5/6 BF16 backend issue the exact alternative request even for the formerly unprobed window. A contract violation, changed historical alternative action, or a capped-source repair that changes an action is ineligible for this uncompensated exact-replay cohort. Preserve the separate earlier compensated-return archive.
reader: Replay both terminal banks on guarded GPU 3 Qwen with batch size two and 30% encoder duty. Verify the native final bank, ordered references for all original questions, and original alternative bank and ordered contexts wherever archived. Earlier training usage has token counts but lacks authenticated response-cache keys. Therefore issue both native and alternative QA prompts on the same bounded BF16 server, deduplicating exact identical prompts. Require exact native answer and F1 parity on every question, plus historical alternative answer parity where available. Retain request digests, tokens, both answers, linked status and any mismatch. Publish a window mean only when the entire window reproduces.
output: Report activity-minus-temporal F1 over every registered question in each complete paired window, separately for terminal-linked and other questions, with all failures in coverage. A reader gain on questions linked only to the prefix is a downstream spillover, never a source-local credit label. No independent test file is consulted. These are additional raw training data only after the whole panel is frozen; they do not change existing forecasts.
